name: Survey tile in Virgo
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 0.4 degrees south of the ecliptic in Virgo, imaged by SPHEREx 20 times in 9 visits over 81 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 42 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 3.4 days starting 2025-05-26, at wavelengths from 0.74 to 4.67 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
